title: Ann Connor — lecture on the Reverend John McMillan
subtitle: Bethel Presbyterian Church, Historical Room — a lecture, 25 September 1983
date_source: Filename, not a slate. The source JSON records that the archive's original capture name for this file was 'Ann-Connor John McMillian 9-25-83' (field date_recorded_basis). The tape carries no spoken date and no copyist's slate, and nothing on it contradicts 25 September 1983. Internal detail agrees with it without proving it: her McMillan genealogy is spoken of as published in 1981, and she describes herself as just retired after 32 and a half years of public-school teaching.

provenance.collection: Bethel Presbyterian Church — Historical Room oral histories
provenance.capture_notes: One cassette capture, ALAC 48 kHz stereo 16-bit, 1,871.445 s, 60,417,099 bytes, md5 6c9a120aa52d6f650473ba60d740ce66 (recomputed here and identical to the md5 in the source notes). Found inside 'JD Patterson - Side A/' under the name 'Ann-Connor John McMillian 9-25-83.m4a', with a byte-identical copy loose at the archive root; moved to this folder and verified by md5 before and after. No crop, no gain, no denoise: the file is the capture as received. Source JSON records date_digitised 2026-10-20.

speakers.label: ANN
speakers.name: Ann Connor
speakers.note: The lecturer, and the compiler of the McMillan genealogy she presents in the first minutes. The surname is never spoken on the tape; it is John Decker's attribution and the content agrees (she speaks as the book's compiler and of 'my husband').

speakers.label: HOST
speakers.name: unidentified woman
speakers.note: 0:00–0:34 only. Introduces Ann in the third person and says she and her husband are members of Venice United Presbyterian Church. Never named on the tape.

speakers.label: HUSBAND
speakers.name: Ann Connor's husband (unnamed)
speakers.note: 1:33–3:27. Passes round a 1935 McMillan reunion photograph he reproduced and numbered himself ('my wife has composed this book'). His name is not on the tape.
